verses.2: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.3: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.4: Behold, the LORD will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

verses.11: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
verses.12: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
verses.14: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the LORD God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.15: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
verses.16: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.17: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
